source.notes: Rewritten into Brian's chapter format from the YouLi copy. No facts added; open questions are in reviewNotes.

reviewNotes: Kala Pathar height: YouLi says 18,519 ft here, but the trek pages say 18,433 ft and 18,448 ft. Which should we use across all three?
Pricing: $6,250 is per tour for 2–4 people. Do we offer it for one person, or more than four? What happens if weather grounds the flight?
Time on Kala Pathar and any health or age limits at that altitude: YouLi only says the visit is based on your comfort level.
YouLi has no day list, so the two chapters are built from the section text. The order (Kala Pathar, breakfast above Namche, lunch in Boudha) follows the overview.

intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Everest Without the Trek
paragraphs: Not everyone has the option of trekking to Everest Base Camp. This tour goes by helicopter. Our guide services begin at your hotel in Kathmandu and cover every detail of the day.

The Kathmandu–Everest–Kathmandu excursion takes 5–6 hours on average. It includes a landing on Kala Pathar, a breakfast with panoramic views, and lunch with your guide in Boudha. Flying through the valleys and around the mountains between the city and the Khumbu is part of the experience.

groups.title: Kala Pathar — Everest Up Close

image.alt: Everest and its neighbors under the sun from Kala Pathar

prose: The approach flies over the Khumbu Valley and lands on top of Kala Pathar. Within the region, this is where the best views of Everest are, from a vantage point slightly higher than Everest Base Camp. Our guides watch your health and safety and lead the visit based on how you feel at altitude.

goodToKnow.label: Good to Know
goodToKnow.heading: Before You Go
goodToKnow.lede: A few things that shape how this day runs.

cards.title: Altitude
cards.body: Kala Pathar is 18,519 feet above sea level. Our guides are attentive to your health and safety and shape the visit around your comfort at high altitude.

cards.title: Group size
cards.body: The price is per tour, for 2–4 people.

cards.title: No overnight
cards.body: This is a day trip, so no accommodation is included. Pickup and drop-off are at your hotel in Kathmandu.

cards.title: Meals
cards.body: Breakfast, tea, coffee and lunch are included.

notes: The price is for the whole tour, not per person.

included: Hotel pickup and drop-off within Kathmandu
excluded: International flights to and from Kathmandu
Alcohol (we strongly encourage little or none while acclimatizing)
Tips for guides (we will explain local tipping customs)
Personal clothing and equipment (we send a packing list)
